response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id, g.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS g ON m.link_to_major = g.major_id GROUP BY m.link_to_major, g.department), shares AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS share FROM major_counts), compared AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS difference FROM shares) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, difference FROM compared WHERE difference > 0 ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;
